movie.title: Due West
movie.overview: A small-town woman in need of medical care in West Texas is forced to break the law.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Facing a dire medical crisis in a remote West Texas town, a desperate woman must cross legal boundaries to secure the care she desperately needs.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In a isolated West Texas community, a small-town woman finds herself trapped by a critical medical emergency and a system that offers no easy solutions. Unable to access proper healthcare through traditional means, she is forced to make a harrowing choice to break the law. As she navigates the consequences of her desperate actions, her journey highlights the harsh realities of survival on the fringes of society. Ultimately, her struggle becomes a fight not just for her own life, but for her dignity in a place that has largely forgotten her.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Set against the rugged and unforgiving backdrop of West Texas, a small-town woman encounters a life-threatening health crisis that requires immediate medical attention. Living in a remote area with extremely limited resources and systemic barriers to healthcare, her options rapidly dwindle as her condition worsens. Realizing that following traditional pathways will leave her without treatment, she reaches a breaking point where legal boundaries no longer hold weight against survival. Pushed into a corner, she executes a risky and illegal scheme to force access to the medical assistance she critically needs. Her desperate act creates ripples throughout her tight-knit community, forcing locals and authorities to confront the desperation hiding beneath the surface of their town. As the law closes in on her, she must deal with the psychological and social ramifications of her choices while continuing her battle against her failing health. The narrative delves deep into her personal history and the isolation that drove her to such extreme measures. Through tension-filled encounters with local law enforcement and sympathetic allies, her story unfolds as a tense drama about moral grey areas. In the end, her journey stands as a powerful testament to human resilience and the extraordinary lengths a person will go to when left with no other choice.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set in the stark landscape of West Texas, this gripping drama follows a small-town woman facing an escalating health crisis in an environment severely lacking in medical infrastructure and support. Plagued by systemic hurdles and a deteriorating condition, she is driven to the edge where compliance with the law becomes a luxury she can no longer afford. Driven by pure survival instinct, she takes matters into her own hands through illegal means, sparking a tense story of conflict, morality, and resilience. The film presents a spoiler-free exploration of the extreme measures individuals take when trapped at the intersection of isolation and necessity.

story_structure.climax: A high-stakes confrontation forces her into a defining moment of crisis, where her survival, medical outcome, and freedom hang in the balance of one ultimate decision.
story_structure.conflict: Faced with a critical health need and a system that fails to support her, she realizes legal avenues are closed, forcing her to cross legal and ethical boundaries to get care.
story_structure.resolution: In the aftermath of the intense ordeal, she must reckon with the legal consequences of her actions and rebuild her life in the harsh realities of West Texas.
story_structure.introduction: A small-town woman lives in an isolated West Texas community where local resources are severely limited and essential medical care is out of reach.
story_structure.risingAction: As she executes a dangerous plan to secure the medical attention she needs, complications mount, raising suspicions among law enforcement and increasing the personal risks she must take to avoid capture.
